raw_data: Independent dental practice, 4 chairs, currently using paper appointment book + occasional Google Calendar. Website has phone number only, no online booking form. Hiring a front-desk coordinator. Recent Google reviews mention long hold times when calling to book.

Residential roofing company, 12 crews. Website is brochure-style. Customers call or fill a contact form. No real-time availability. Recently ran Facebook ads for storm damage. Owner mentioned in a local podcast that no-shows and last-minute cancellations waste crew time.

HVAC installation & repair. 8 technicians. Currently using ServiceTitan for dispatch but still taking new customer bookings over phone. Looking for a lighter online booking option for residential clients. Job posting for Customer Experience Coordinator mentions reducing phone volume.

Two-location family dental group. Uses Dentrix for clinical charts but booking is still mostly phone + paper day sheets at the front desk. Staff turnover high; new hires struggle with the booking process. Interested in patient self-scheduling.

Residential + light commercial plumbing. 6 trucks. Website has a contact form that emails the office; no calendar integration. Frequently double-books emergency calls. Exploring tools after a busy storm season.

Regional 3PL with 200+ employees. Approvals for rate exceptions and carrier changes currently live in email threads and spreadsheets. Compliance team complains about missing audit trails. Recently raised Series B; growth is outpacing process maturity.

B2B SaaS CS org, 40 CSMs. Escalation and credit approvals go through Slack + email. No single source of truth for who approved what. Looking for lightweight workflow tool that does not require full IT project.

Mid-market manufacturing company finance team. PO approvals and vendor onboarding still paper + email. Audit prep takes weeks. Controller evaluating tools that give role-based routing and exportable audit logs without SAP-level complexity.

Manages 1,200 residential units. Maintenance ticket approvals and vendor spend over $500 require manager sign-off via email. Wants mobile-friendly approvals and better visibility for regional managers.
Outpatient PT clinic, 3 therapists. Booking done by phone; website is static. High no-show rate on first visits. Considering online booking + deposit collection after reading industry blogs.
